text:
Maria: Quick design/dev sync for the benchmark launch visuals + webinar format. Need to lock: 2 hero visuals, one sales-ready chart, and the webinar CTA flow. Keep messaging punchy and exec-friendly.

Alex: Hero A: " + "Latency waterfall (P50 → P95 → P99) with a simple annotated arrow for batching improvements." + " Hero B: " + "Cost skyline: normalized $/1k tokens across model families (stacked bars showing quantized vs fp16)." + " Keep palettes high contrast.

Jon: Add a tiny KPI badge on each hero: avg latency and $/1k. People scan images fast.

Casey: Sales chart idea: a 3-column 'Start → Scale → Secure' with numbers: hosted latency band, dedicated optimized band, private deployment note.

Pritam: Routing CTAs: 
- SMB: "Try Hosted (free credits)" -> track utm_campaign=bench_launch_smb
- Mid-market: "Request Dedicated trial" -> track utm_campaign=bench_launch_mid
- Enterprise: "Contact Sales for Private" -> track utm_campaign=bench_launch_enterprise
Add a hidden form field 'workload_type' to capture primary use-case.

Alex: Quick mock data CSV for charts:
```
model,median_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_fp16,cost_quant
redwood-3b,40,110,280,0.18,0.12
redwood-13b,85,250,520,0.65,0.40
redwood-70b,140,390,900,1.30,0.85
```
Use fixed color for quantized bars.

Nora: DesignBot: exported figma frames -> https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bench-v1 (view+comment). Also generated alt text suggestions for accessibility.

Maria: Messaging options for hero headline (choose one):
A) "Latency you can budget for. Costs you can predict."
B) "Serve faster. Pay less per token."

Jon: Leaning A: more enterprise-friendly.

Casey: For webinar: 18min product + 15min customer case + 20min live Q/demo. Promo copy should call out "real-world token economics" and invite attendees to bring a sample prompt.

Pritam: Measurement: create 3 tracking links and a GA event for each CTA click. Also tag landing page with a feature flag so we can swap hero variations and A/B test.

Maria: Decisions locked: Hero visuals = waterfall + cost skyline; Sales chart = Start/Scale/Secure microfunnel; Headline = A. Alex -> PNG exports + alt text by EOD. Casey -> sales slide copy and funnel SVG. Jon -> webinar outline and promo blurb. Pritam -> tracking links and GA events. I'll assemble the draft deck and share for review at 9am tomorrow.

Alex: Quick Q — should hero show absolute $ or normalized index?

Maria: Sales slide needs absolute $; hero can use normalized with a small footnote for absolute numbers on click-through.

Casey: Routing copy draft for buttons: SMB="Start free trial", Mid-market="Request dedicated demo", Enterprise="Talk to solutions". Keep verbs clear.

Maria: Perfect. Thanks all — will ping when draft is live. :rocket:
